<script setup lang="ts">
import {computed,onMounted,ref,watch} from 'vue';import {nativeBridgeAvailable} from '../lib/host-capabilities.ts';
import {useModelSettings} from '../stores/models';import {useOrganizer} from '../stores/organizer';import {useAgents} from '../stores/agents';
import {usableModel,object} from '../domain/model-catalog';import {runError,type ModelDefinition} from '../domain/organizer';import {displayTime} from '../domain/todos';
import Icon from './Icon.vue';import SkField from './ui/SkField.vue';import SkInput from './ui/SkInput.vue';import SkSelect from './ui/SkSelect.vue';import SkSecretInput from './ui/SkSecretInput.vue';import SkFieldset from './ui/SkFieldset.vue';import SkButton from './ui/SkButton.vue';import SkSwitch from './ui/SkSwitch.vue';import SkNumberInput from './ui/SkNumberInput.vue';import SkSaveBar from './ui/SkSaveBar.vue';
const model=useModelSettings(),organizer=useOrganizer(),agents=useAgents(),testChoice=ref(''),confirmDialog=ref<HTMLDialogElement>(),deletion=ref<{kind:'provider'|'model';id:string;name:string}|null>(null);
const p=computed(()=>model.providerDraft!),m=computed(()=>model.modelDraft),initial=computed(()=>model.initialModel);
const providers=computed(()=>[...(model.configuration?.providers.providers||[]).map(p=>({id:p.id,name:p.name||p.id,enabled:p.enabled!==false})),...Object.values(model.providerDrafts).filter(d=>!d.base&&!model.findProvider(d.value.id)).map(d=>({id:d.value.id,name:d.value.name||'新供应商 · 未保存',enabled:d.value.enabled}))]);
const rows=computed<ModelDefinition[]>(()=>[...(model.configuration?.models.models.filter(m=>m.providerId===model.selectedProvider)||[]),...Object.values(model.modelDrafts).filter(d=>!d.base&&d.value.providerId===model.selectedProvider&&!model.findModel(d.value.id)).map(d=>({id:d.value.id,providerId:d.value.providerId,name:d.value.name||'新模型 · 未保存',apiModelId:d.value.apiModelId||'API标识待填写',limits:{maxInputTokens:d.value.context,maxOutputTokens:d.value.maxOutput},capabilities:{toolCall:d.value.tools}}))]);
const options=computed(()=>model.configuration?.models.models.filter(m=>usableModel(model.configuration,m.id)).map(m=>({value:m.id,label:m.name||m.apiModelId,description:m.apiModelId,group:model.findProvider(m.providerId)?.name||m.providerId}))||[]);
const defaultChoice=computed({get:()=>model.globalDraft||model.configuration?.defaultModelId||'',set:(value:string)=>{model.globalDraft=value===model.configuration?.defaultModelId?'':value;}});
const effectiveTest=computed(()=>model.selectedModel||testChoice.value),testOptions=computed(()=>rows.value.filter(m=>usableModel(model.configuration,m.id)).map(m=>({value:m.id,label:m.name||m.apiModelId,description:m.apiModelId})));
const testRun=computed(()=>organizer.run?.kind==='test'&&organizer.run.snapshot.modelId===effectiveTest.value?organizer.run:null);
const testBusy=computed(()=>!!testRun.value&&organizer.running),blocked=computed(()=>!model.ready||model.loading||model.saving);
const credential=computed(()=>model.configuration?.credentialStatus[model.selectedProvider]);
// Credential reference status. The web surface speaks the frozen §7 vocabulary
// `available | missing | unavailable`; the native bridge historically reported
// `stored` / `environment`.
//
//   `available`  the REFERENCE RESOLVES — it is NOT a claim that a secret is
//                persisted in an OS store, so it must never be rendered as
//                "已保存".
//   `missing`    the reference is KNOWN but no value resolves for it. That says
//                nothing about whether anything was ever saved, so the copy is
//                deliberately neutral ("未解析到值") and never asserts
//                "尚未保存" — the reference being configured and its value
//                being absent are different facts.
//
// The internal status shape is unchanged.
const credentialLabel=computed(()=>{
  if(credential.value==='available')return '凭据引用可解析';
  if(credential.value==='stored')return '已有钥匙串凭据';
  if(credential.value==='environment')return '当前使用宿主环境变量';
  if(credential.value==='missing')return '凭据引用未解析到值';
  if(credential.value==='unavailable')return '凭据引用不可用';
  return '凭据状态未知';
});
const credentialResolved=computed(()=>credential.value==='available'||credential.value==='stored'||credential.value==='environment');
// Credential input copy, by the pipe that will actually run.
//
//   native (Tauri bridge present): the typed secret is written to the OS
//     keychain under a freshly generated reference, and the provider is
//     repointed at it. It is never written into the configuration file, and an
//     existing key is never read back.
//   web (plain browser): there is no keychain, so a typed secret has nowhere to
//     go. The save is refused with PLAIN_CREDENTIAL rather than silently
//     dropped, so the copy must say so up front instead of promising a save
//     that cannot happen.
const keychainPipe=nativeBridgeAvailable();
const keyHelp=computed(()=>{
  if(!keychainPipe)return '浏览器模式没有钥匙串：请改用环境变量引用，或在桌面端填写密钥。';
  return credentialResolved.value?'凭据引用可解析；留空保留原引用。':'密钥将写入系统钥匙串，不回读已有密钥明文。';
});
const keyPlaceholder=computed(()=>keychainPipe?(credentialResolved.value?'引用已配置 · 留空保留':'填写密钥'):'请改用环境变量引用');
const effortOptions=computed(()=>{const declaration=object(model.findModel(model.selectedModel||'')?.reasoning);const allowed=Array.isArray(declaration.supportedEfforts)?declaration.supportedEfforts:['minimal','low','medium','high','xhigh','max'];return [{value:'default',label:'由服务决定'},{value:'off',label:'关闭',disabled:declaration.canDisableThinking===false||declaration.onlyReasoning===true},...(['minimal','low','medium','high','xhigh','max'] as const).filter(v=>allowed.includes(v)).map(v=>({value:v,label:({minimal:'最少',low:'较低',medium:'标准',high:'较高',xhigh:'更高',max:'最高'})[v]}))];});
watch(()=>model.selectedProvider,()=>{testChoice.value=testOptions.value[0]?.value||'';},{immediate:true});watch(testOptions,value=>{if(!value.some(o=>o.value===testChoice.value))testChoice.value=value[0]?.value||'';});
function isDraft(id:string){return !model.findModel(id)&&!!model.modelDrafts[id];}
function uses(id:string){const names:string[]=[];if(model.configuration?.defaultModelId===id)names.push('全局默认');for(const [role,row] of Object.entries(agents.states)){if(row.config&&(row.config.modelId||model.configuration?.defaultModelId)===id)names.push(({organizer:'事项整理',tracker:'进展跟踪',advisor:'工作参谋'})[role as 'organizer']);}return names.join('、')||'未分配';}
async function save(){try{if(model.selectedModel)await model.saveModel();else await model.saveProvider();}catch{}}
async function applyDefault(){try{await model.applyDefault();}catch{}}
async function test(){if(model.dirty||blocked.value||!usableModel(model.configuration,effectiveTest.value))return;try{await organizer.testModel(effectiveTest.value);}catch{}}
function ask(kind:'provider'|'model',id:string,name:string){deletion.value={kind,id,name};confirmDialog.value?.showModal();}
async function remove(){if(!deletion.value)return;try{if(deletion.value.kind==='provider')await model.removeProvider(deletion.value.id);else await model.removeModel(deletion.value.id);confirmDialog.value?.close();}catch{confirmDialog.value?.close();}}
onMounted(async()=>{if(!model.ready)try{await model.load();}catch{}for(const role of ['organizer','tracker','advisor'] as const)if(!agents.states[role].ready)void agents.load(role).catch(()=>{});});
</script>
<template><div class="catalog-page"><Teleport defer to="#settings-heading-actions"><div class="catalog-default"><SkField label="全局默认模型"><div class="catalog-default-row"><SkSelect v-model="defaultChoice" :options="options" :disabled="blocked||!model.configuration" searchable placeholder="先添加模型服务"/><SkButton v-if="model.globalDraft" kind="entry" :disabled="blocked" @click="applyDefault">应用</SkButton></div></SkField></div></Teleport>
<p v-if="model.loading" role="status">正在读取模型配置…</p><div v-if="!model.ready&&!model.loading" class="profile-alert" role="alert"><p>{{model.error||'模型配置尚未确认，请重新读取后继续。'}}</p><SkButton kind="entry" :disabled="model.loading" @click="model.load().catch(()=>{})">重新读取，保留草稿</SkButton></div>
<div v-if="!providers.length&&!model.loading" class="catalog-empty"><h2>先为班班接入一个模型服务。</h2><p>供应商统一管理认证，多个模型可分配给不同的内置智能体。</p><SkButton kind="entry" :disabled="!model.ready" @click="model.addProvider()"><Icon name="plus"/>添加第一个服务</SkButton></div>
<div v-else class="catalog-layout"><aside class="catalog-rail" aria-label="供应商列表"><div class="catalog-rail-title"><span>供应商</span><span>{{providers.length}}</span></div><button v-for="provider in providers" :key="provider.id" class="catalog-provider" :class="{active:model.selectedProvider===provider.id}" :disabled="model.saving" @click="model.selectProvider(provider.id)"><span><strong>{{provider.name}}</strong><small>{{model.configuration?.models.models.filter(m=>m.providerId===provider.id).length||0}} 个模型 · {{provider.enabled?'已启用':'已停用'}}</small></span><Icon v-if="model.selectedProvider===provider.id" name="check"/></button><SkButton kind="quiet" :disabled="blocked" @click="model.addProvider()"><Icon name="plus"/>新增供应商</SkButton></aside>
<section class="catalog-editor" aria-label="服务与模型编辑"><template v-if="p&&!m"><div class="catalog-object-heading"><div><h2>{{model.findProvider(p.id)?.name||'新增供应商'}}</h2><p>{{model.findProvider(p.id)?.apiFormat&&model.findProvider(p.id)?.apiFormat!=='openai-compatible'?'未适配：'+model.findProvider(p.id)?.apiFormat:'OpenAI兼容接口'}} · {{rows.length}} 个模型</p></div><div class="catalog-object-actions"><SkSwitch v-model="p.enabled" label="启用供应商" :disabled="blocked"/><template v-if="model.findProvider(p.id)"><SkSelect v-model="testChoice" :options="testOptions" aria-label="连接测试使用的模型" :disabled="blocked||model.dirty" placeholder="先添加模型"/><SkButton :disabled="blocked||model.dirty||organizer.running||agents.running||!effectiveTest" :loading="testBusy" @click="test"><Icon name="refresh"/>测试连接</SkButton><button class="icon-button" type="button" aria-label="删除供应商" title="删除供应商" :disabled="blocked" @click="ask('provider',p.id,p.name)"><Icon name="trash"/></button></template></div></div>
<SkFieldset :disabled="blocked"><form @submit.prevent="save"><div class="form-grid"><SkField label="显示名称" required><SkInput v-model="p.name" maxlength="100" placeholder="例如：公司模型网关"/></SkField><SkField label="接口协议"><div class="catalog-protocol">{{model.findProvider(p.id)?.apiFormat&&model.findProvider(p.id)?.apiFormat!=='openai-compatible'?'当前未适配':'OpenAI兼容'}}<small>当前适配路径</small></div></SkField><SkField class="full" label="服务地址" required><SkInput v-model="p.baseUrl" type="url" placeholder="https://gateway.example.com/v1"/></SkField><SkField label="认证方式"><SkSelect v-model="p.authMode" :options="[{value:'key',label:'API Key · 钥匙串'},{value:'env',label:'环境变量引用'}]"/></SkField><SkField v-if="p.authMode==='env'" label="环境变量名称" required><SkInput v-model="p.env" placeholder="例如：SIDEKICK_API_KEY" autocomplete="off"/></SkField><SkField v-else label="API Key" :help="keyHelp"><SkSecretInput :model-value="model.keys[p.id]||''" :placeholder="keyPlaceholder" @update:model-value="model.keys[p.id]=$event"/><p class="muted" role="status">{{ credentialLabel }}</p></SkField></div>
<details class="catalog-advanced"><summary>连接选项</summary><div class="form-grid"><SkField label="单次请求超时（秒）"><SkNumberInput v-model="p.timeout" :min="1" :max="120"/></SkField><SkField label="失败重试次数"><SkNumberInput v-model="p.retries" :min="0" :max="2"/></SkField></div><p class="muted">重试与工具循环共同受任务总时限约束。</p><div class="catalog-section-heading"><h3>非秘密请求头</h3><button class="text-button" type="button" @click="p.headers.push({name:'',value:''})"><Icon name="plus"/>添加</button></div><div v-for="(header,index) in p.headers" :key="index" class="catalog-header-row"><SkInput v-model="header.name" :aria-label="`请求头${index+1}名称`" placeholder="请求头名称"/><SkInput v-model="header.value" :aria-label="`请求头${index+1}值`" placeholder="固定值，认证信息请用凭据引用"/><button class="icon-button" type="button" :aria-label="`移除请求头${index+1}`" @click="p.headers.splice(index,1)"><Icon name="close"/></button></div></details>
<section v-if="initial" class="catalog-model-section"><div class="catalog-section-heading"><h3>第一个模型</h3><small class="muted">与供应商一起保存</small></div><div class="form-grid"><SkField label="模型显示名称" required><SkInput v-model="initial.name" placeholder="例如：我的主力模型"/></SkField><SkField label="API 模型标识" required><SkInput v-model="initial.apiModelId" placeholder="服务商提供的model / deployment ID"/></SkField></div></section></form></SkFieldset>
<section v-if="!initial" class="catalog-model-section"><div class="catalog-section-heading"><h3>模型 <small>{{rows.length}} 个</small></h3><SkButton kind="entry" :disabled="blocked||!model.findProvider(p.id)" @click="model.addModel()"><Icon name="plus"/>新增模型</SkButton></div><p v-if="!rows.length" class="muted">为这个服务添加第一个模型，再分配给班班的不同角色。</p><table v-else class="catalog-model-table"><thead><tr><th>模型</th><th>能力</th><th class="catalog-limits">上下文／输出</th><th class="catalog-bindings">正在使用</th><th>操作</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr v-for="row in rows" :key="row.id"><td><button class="text-button catalog-model-name" :disabled="blocked" @click="model.editModel(row.id)">{{row.name||row.apiModelId}}</button><span v-if="row.id===model.configuration?.defaultModelId" class="pill catalog-default-tag">默认</span><small>{{row.apiModelId}}{{isDraft(row.id)?' · 未保存':usableModel(model.configuration,row.id)?'':' · 已停用'}}</small></td><td><span class="pill">{{object(row.capabilities).toolCall!==false?'工具调用':'文本'}}</span><span v-if="object(row.reasoning).supported" class="pill">推理</span></td><td class="catalog-limits">{{Number(object(row.limits).maxInputTokens||32000).toLocaleString()}} / {{Number(object(row.limits).maxOutputTokens||4096).toLocaleString()}}</td><td class="catalog-bindings">{{uses(row.id)}}</td><td><div class="catalog-row-actions"><button class="icon-button" type="button" title="编辑模型" :aria-label="`编辑模型 ${row.name||row.apiModelId}`" :disabled="blocked" @click="model.editModel(row.id)"><Icon name="edit"/></button><button class="icon-button" type="button" title="删除模型" :aria-label="`删除模型 ${row.name||row.apiModelId}`" :disabled="blocked" @click="ask('model',row.id,row.name||row.apiModelId)"><Icon name="trash"/></button></div></td></tr></tbody></table></section>
</template>
<template v-else-if="m"><button class="text-button catalog-back" :disabled="model.saving" @click="model.backToProvider()">返回供应商模型列表<Icon name="arrow"/></button><div class="catalog-object-heading"><div><h2>{{model.findModel(m.id)?m.name:'新增模型'}}</h2><p>所属服务：{{model.findProvider(m.providerId)?.name}}</p></div><SkButton v-if="model.findModel(m.id)" :disabled="blocked||model.dirty||organizer.running||agents.running||!usableModel(model.configuration,m.id)" :loading="testBusy" @click="test">测试当前模型</SkButton></div><SkFieldset :disabled="blocked"><form @submit.prevent="save"><div class="form-grid"><SkField label="显示名称" required><SkInput v-model="m.name" maxlength="100"/></SkField><SkField label="API 模型标识" required><SkInput v-model="m.apiModelId" maxlength="256"/></SkField><SkField label="上下文窗口（tokens）"><SkNumberInput v-model="m.context" :min="1024" :max="2000000" :step="1024"/></SkField><SkField label="最大输出（tokens）" help="这是上限；实际输出还受剩余上下文、安全余量与任务时限限制。"><SkNumberInput v-model="m.maxOutput" :min="1" :max="Math.min(Number(m.context)||262144,262144)" :step="256"/></SkField><SkField label="说明" class="full"><SkInput v-model="m.description" placeholder="可选，方便后续选择模型"/></SkField></div><div class="catalog-switch-row"><span><strong>启用模型</strong><small>停用前需调整全局默认和角色分配。</small></span><SkSwitch v-model="m.enabled" label="启用模型"/></div><div class="catalog-switch-row"><span><strong>工具调用</strong><small>用于声明模型支持工具；不代表Skills／MCP已接入。</small></span><SkSwitch v-model="m.tools" label="工具调用"/></div><div class="catalog-switch-row"><span><strong>推理能力</strong><small>由模型及接口适配共同支持，按服务返回验证。</small></span><SkSwitch v-model="m.reasoning" label="推理能力"/></div><SkField v-if="m.reasoning" class="catalog-effort" label="默认推理强度" help="由服务决定时不发送推理控制；不支持的强度会明确报错。"><SkSelect v-model="m.effort" :options="effortOptions"/></SkField><details class="catalog-advanced"><summary>采样与显示选项</summary><div class="form-grid"><SkField label="Temperature（可选）"><SkNumberInput v-model="m.temperature" :min="0" :max="2" :step="0.1" placeholder="留空使用服务默认"/></SkField><SkField label="Top P（可选）"><SkNumberInput v-model="m.topP" :min="0" :max="1" :step="0.1" placeholder="留空使用服务默认"/></SkField><SkField class="full" label="别名（可选）"><SkInput v-model="m.aliases" placeholder="用逗号分隔，用于识别模型"/></SkField></div></details><details class="catalog-advanced"><summary>成本记录（可选）</summary><div class="form-grid"><SkField label="计价货币"><SkSelect v-model="m.currency" :options="[{value:'CNY',label:'人民币 CNY'},{value:'USD',label:'美元 USD'}]"/></SkField><SkField :label="`输入 / ${m.priceUnit}`"><SkNumberInput v-model="m.priceInput" :min="0" :step="0.1" placeholder="未填写"/></SkField><SkField :label="`输出 / ${m.priceUnit}`"><SkNumberInput v-model="m.priceOutput" :min="0" :step="0.1" placeholder="未填写"/></SkField><SkField :label="`缓存读取 / ${m.priceUnit}`"><SkNumberInput v-model="m.priceCache" :min="0" :step="0.1" placeholder="未填写"/></SkField></div><p class="muted">仅保存本地记录；未填写保持未知，不代表免费或实时价格。</p></details></form></SkFieldset></template>
<div v-if="testRun" class="connection-result" role="status"><span v-if="model.dirty||testRun.snapshot.revision!==model.configuration?.revision">配置已变化；此结果对应先前保存的模型。</span><span v-else-if="testBusy">正在实际调用 {{model.findModel(effectiveTest)?.name||effectiveTest}}…</span><span v-else-if="testRun.status==='succeeded'">连接测试通过，模型已真实响应。{{displayTime(testRun.finishedAtMs||testRun.createdAtMs)}}</span><span v-else>{{runError(testRun)}}</span><button v-if="testBusy" class="text-button" @click="organizer.cancel().catch(()=>{})">取消测试</button></div><p v-if="organizer.error" class="form-error" role="alert">{{organizer.error}}</p>
</section></div><SkSaveBar v-if="p||m" target="#settings-save-slot" :dirty="model.dirty" :busy="model.saving" :disabled="!model.ready||model.loading" :error="model.error" :notice="model.notice" :label="m?'保存模型':initial?'保存服务与首个模型':'保存服务'" @save="save" @discard="model.discard"/>
<dialog ref="confirmDialog" class="dialog confirm-dialog" aria-labelledby="catalog-delete-heading" @cancel.prevent="!model.saving&&confirmDialog?.close()"><header class="dialog-header"><h2 id="catalog-delete-heading">删除{{deletion?.kind==='provider'?'供应商':'模型'}}？</h2></header><div class="dialog-body"><p>{{deletion?.name}}</p><p class="muted">被全局默认或智能体使用时需要先调整分配；本操作不删除远端服务。</p></div><footer class="dialog-footer"><SkButton :disabled="model.saving" @click="confirmDialog?.close()">取消</SkButton><SkButton kind="danger" :loading="model.saving" @click="remove">确认删除</SkButton></footer></dialog></div></template>
